Chinese American Women Oral History Project

collection

Collection of oral histories that center around life in China, emigration and settlement in the United States, family life, education, work, ethnic identity, assimilation and acculturation, and continuing ties to China. Primarily consists of audiotapes. The Chinese Historical Society of New England also has copies of this collection that are not processed or digitized.

Archival Collection

Access Policy Notes
This collection is mostly open for research, but some folders are restricted and sensitive material may be screened by the archivist.
Project Status
The records have been mostly digitized and are available on Harvard Library's archives portal. The material is also available to consult in person at Harvard.
